S7 Class for the Separable Penalty

Source: R/distrib_penalty.R
DistribPenalty.Rd

DistribPenalty is the class of the penalties that distrib_penalty() builds. Such a penalty is formed by applying a distributions7 log-density to the successive blocks of \(D\beta\). Beyond the seven properties that every penalty carries, the class stores the parent distribution, the points where the parent's log-density has a kink, the block width (one for a univariate parent and the dimension for a multivariate one) and the log-Jacobian of the map.

Usage

DistribPenalty(
  penalty_name = character(0),
  map = NULL,
  n_coef = integer(0),
  params = character(0),
  params_bounds = list(),
  link_params = list(),
  params_smooth = logical(0),
  parent = NULL,
  kinks = integer(0),
  block = integer(0),
  log_jacobian = NA_real_
)

Arguments

penalty_name

A single string naming the penalty, used by print() and by any code that reports which penalty a block carries.

map

The matrix \(D\), of \(m\) rows and \(q\) columns, or NULL for the identity. A Matrix object is kept in its own storage, so a diagonal map, such as the map that standardization produces, is recognized as diagonal by its class.

n_coef

The number of coefficients \(q\). The value is a single whole number.

params

The hyperparameter names, in the order by which every derivative list is keyed. The value is character(0) for a penalty with none.

params_bounds

A named list with one entry per hyperparameter, and each entry is a numeric pair giving an open interval. A value at either endpoint is rejected, so (0, Inf) excludes zero.

link_params

A named list, one linkfunctions7 link per hyperparameter, carrying that hyperparameter's own interval onto the whole real line.

params_smooth

A logical vector, one entry per hyperparameter, TRUE where the value is differentiable in it.

parent

The distributions7 object that supplies the log-density, usually a distributions7::fixed() wrapper holding the location at zero.

kinks

A numeric vector of the points where the parent's log-density is not differentiable in its argument, possibly empty. distrib_penalty() derives it with distrib_kinks() unless its argument kinks is supplied.

block

The block width: 1L for a univariate parent and the parent's n_dim for a multivariate one.

log_jacobian

\(\log\lvert\det D\rvert\), computed by map_log_jacobian() when the penalty is built: 0 without a map, a finite number for a square nonsingular map, and NA for a map that is not square or is singular. The default is NA.

Value

An S7 object of class DistribPenalty, inheriting from penalty(), with the seven inherited properties and the four above.

Details

The hyperparameters are the parent's own free parameters. The properties params, params_bounds, link_params and params_smooth are copied from the distribution object, so the hyperparameters of the penalty, their bounds, their links and their smoothness are those of the parent.

Methods

The list below gives the methods registered on this class, by the page that documents each.

  • The value and its coefficient derivatives: penalty_value(), penalty_gradient() and penalty_hessian().

  • The hyperparameter derivatives: penalty_grad_theta(), penalty_hess_theta() and penalty_cross().

  • The predicates and the structure of the prior: penalty_kinks(), is_proper(), penalty_null_basis() and penalty_readable().

  • The higher derivatives of a marginal criterion: penalty_dhessian(), penalty_d2hessian(), penalty_dcross() and beta_quadratic().

  • The movement of the Hessian with the coefficients: penalty_dhessian_beta(), penalty_d2hessian_beta() and penalty_dhessian_beta_theta().

  • The proximal operator and the draws: penalty_prox(), penalty_prox_spec() and penalty_draw().

The class registers no is_quadratic(), penalty_matrix(), penalty_rank() or penalty_logpdet() method, so the methods of the base class penalty() are used for those generics.

See also

distrib_penalty() for the constructor, ridge_penalty() and its siblings for the named instances, penalty_value.DistribPenalty() for the value of the penalty.

Examples

pen <- lasso_penalty(n_coef = 2)
S7::S7_inherits(pen, DistribPenalty)
#> [1] TRUE

# The parent is a fixed Laplace, the kink is at zero, the blocks are single
# coordinates, and the hyperparameter is the rate of the parent.
pen@parent
#> Distribution: Fixed Laplace2 [mu=0]
#> Type:         Continuous
#> Dimensions:   univariate
#> 
#> Parameters:
#>   lambda (rate)               | Link: log        | Domain: (0, Inf)
#> 
#> Fixed:
#>   mu = 0
pen@kinks
#> [1] 0
pen@block
#> [1] 1
pen@params
#> [1] "lambda"

# Without a map the log-Jacobian is zero.
pen@log_jacobian
#> [1] 0
